/--
`Subrelation q r` means that `q ⊆ r` or `∀ x y, q x y → r x y`.
It is the analogue of the subset relation on relations.
-/
def Subrelation {α : Sort u} (q r : α → α → Prop) :=
  ∀ {x y}, q x y → r x y
